svg.title: Failover
svg.desc: The trips API reaches DB 1 through the DNS name db.trips while a health checker pings it. DB 1 loses power and misses three checks in a row. The checker promotes DB 2 to primary, fences DB 1, and DNS now points db.trips at DB 2, so the API's queries flow again.
svg.text: Three missed checks in a row: promote the replica and move DNS to it.
